steps.content:
Heart notes:
saffron, labdanum, patchouli
Cassia, you're the perfumer behind the gala, aren't you?
What was the purpose of the perfume gala? Why did you sell and distribute these Mania perfumes? Please answer me directly!

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: So that the whole world doesn't become suffocating... like in here.
You lift your head for the umpteenth time to gather your thoughts, trying not to be affected by the woman's blunt indifference and perfunctory attitude.

Your premonition has come true. In the past half hour of interrogation, the only practical information you've obtained is her name, Cassia. Any other question is met with her brief criticism of the smell in the interrogation room.
But it doesn't seem like she's dismissing you by lying or avoiding the questions.
You notice that since entering the interrogation room, her complexion has been awful. Her skin is a sickly pale color and her breathing is labored.
I'm sorry if you really can't stand the smell of the interrogation room. But I can't give you back the perfume bottle...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: No! What is this?! It smells bloody...
The unexpected happens. Just as you switch strategies and try to persuade Cassia to reveal the truth, she suddenly curls up and covers her face in horror, screaming shrilly.
Cassia...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: No, this smell... Get it away from me...!
After the initial shock at Cassia's sudden breakdown, your first reaction is to check for potential triggers in the interrogation room.
The light, the sound... and even the smell, which has the strongest effect on this Sinner, none of these elements have undergone any noticeable changes before and after her breakdown.
The smell she mentioned seems more like an illusion induced by emotions than real sensory perception. To suppress an emotional outburst of this intensity, the only way is...
To further enhance the calming effect of the shackles, you end up almost embracing the curled-up Cassia in your arms.
Shh, there now...
You can feel her trembling, her skin cool to the touch like a small creature desperately withstanding a storm. The scent you once detected on her is now almost completely gone.
She is afraid. You don't know what she fears, but the feeling transmitted from the other end of the shackles tells you that she is trying to escape from some immense fear that has devoured her soul.
You're in the Bureau's interrogation room now. It's absolutely safe here. Don't be scared... Cassia, Cassia!
Time slips away. Perhaps the shackles have conveyed your thoughts to Cassia, as she finally calms down from her fear, her breathing and heartbeat returning to normal.
How do you feel? Are you okay? Why... why are you looking at me like that?

You take a few steps back to observe Cassia's complexion, only to find that her expression has turned strange. She is staring at you, her gaze tracing the contours of your face, as if admiring a rare gem.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Such a unique fragrance...
Fragrance?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: I've never smelled such a fragrance before... It's solemn, warm, and firm... Ah, how special, how wonderful...
Hmm...
You don't understand what fragrance she's referring to, just as you couldn't perceive the bloody smell she mumbled about earlier.
But based on past experience, you should go along with her for now. This way, you may get more information in the upcoming interrogation and find a breakthrough.
...Just now, did you react that way because you smelled something unpleasant?
If you need it, I can have Nightingale bring in some perfume to help stabilize your mood.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: No, no need.
A delicate blush appears on Cassia's pale cheeks. Those previously indifferent eyes are now focused on you, reflecting a captivating light.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Those mediocre commercial fragrances will only intensify the foul smell here... I just need you, I just need to smell your scent...
Her inexplicable change baffles you.

Not only is the Sinner not under your control, but she's also completely immersed in her own world. But at least, her attitude seems to have softened, and you can try to guide her to reveal more details.
I can't smell the foul smell you mentioned or the fragrance on myself. Do these smells really exist? And how are they related to what just happened to you?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: ...Are you actually asking a perfumer if the smells she detects really exist?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Well, I guess this straightforward and realistic character also makes up part of that vibrant scent of yours...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Alright, I respect everything that contributes to your fragrance. And I will do my part to further elicit your sweet scent... That includes teaching a barbarian like you who's ignorant of the beauty of fragrance what defines a supreme scent.
Then I'm all ears.
She seems completely oblivious to the hint of caution in your tone, and continues with the air of a lecturer eager to share all her knowledge.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: As a perfumer in pursuit of perfection, I'm always searching for aromatic ingredients, extracting raw materials, and adjusting formulas...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: And what helps me grasp the most subtle nuances, concoct the perfect fragrances, and ultimately craft masterpieces, is my sense of smell.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: This is a gift from God... I'm not like regular people who cannot discern different smells mixed together. I can smell everything distinctly, especially living things.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: In my perception, warm flesh and blood emit a variety of unique scents. The vain, the youthful, the insipid... These are the most fundamental scents that only I can detect.

Could she be talking about the smell of pheromones? Scientifically, some people are indeed born with a vomeronasal organ similar to that of an early human and therefore can perceive a wider range of smells.
Perhaps that so-called scent on you falls in that range too, so it's not entirely an illusion.
Like that bloody smell you mentioned earlier?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: It was from an immensely shocking incident I once experienced. The smell of blood at that time was forever imprinted on my mind because of my sensitive sense of smell.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: I can't get rid of it. It follows me like a shadow, making me uneasy and restless...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Fortunately, my ability allows me to make a perfume with special effects which clears and masks that haunting smell... I can only stay calm under the shroud of the special perfume.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Once my ability stops functioning, I will smell that chilling bloody smell again...
At this point, the reason for her sudden breakdown just now becomes clear.
You directly restrained her special power the moment you put the shackles on her. Stripped of the special enhancement, the perfume can no longer mask the bloody smell.
I'm sorry. I only used the shackles on you to prevent you from harming others with your ability, not to make you suffer.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Shackles... That's what that connection transmitting your scent is called?
Unexpectedly, Cassia interrupts you. A soft smile appears on her face, illuminating her pale and cold face. But for some reason, you feel an indescribable zeal from this smile.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: It is the shackles that restrict my ability and remind me of the fear and bloodiness. But they also bring me your fragrance, driving away the terrible bloody smell...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: It's the shackles that have finally led me to this fragrance... A fragrance that functions on its own to erase my fear and save my precarious spirit, with no need for other ingredients... Finally.
Her demeanor is all decent, but that can't hide the fact that she is really hard to communicate with. To not let the interrogation end in a stalemate again, you must be straightforward.
Since the shackles have calmed you down, let's get back to the point, Cassia.
I hope you can tell me why you sold the perfumes made with your ability at the galas?
And why did you name these perfumes after people? What is the connection between these names and the victims of the serial disappearance case? Why do they highly coincide?

You've just admitted yourself that you can smell the scent of living beings. According to the testimonies of the victims' families, they were able to smell the victims' body scent from the personalized perfumes you made.

It's logical for me to deduce that you not only have met the victims of the missing persons cases, but have also made certain contact with them. Only in this way could you concoct perfumes that matched their scents.
Cassia remains unfazed under your relentless questioning, showing no signs of guilt or unease.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Personalized perfumes? Haha... I'd prefer something more poetic, but it does perfectly capture the core inspiration.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Yes, inspiration. Perfumery requires not only suitable ingredients, a keen sense of smell, and steady hands, but also a spark of creativity to guide you in the right direction...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: And these... people, according to you, these beautiful girls, and their exquisite bodies... They are the main source of inspiration for my perfumery.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: The earliest perfume formulas often drew inspiration from existing scents in nature, extracting and recreating them.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: What I want is to recreate an atmosphere, an emotion, or an experience... to recreate the captivating texture of the youthful beauties and their unique charms...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: That's why I'm constantly on the lookout for beauties that meet my requirements, concocting unique perfumes named after them...
Cassia talks enthusiastically with a fervor that only surfaces when she speaks about perfume.
So are you admitting that you made contact with the victims for the sake of perfume-making? Did you harm or abduct them?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: I did have deep interactions with them. After all, they were the essential ingredients for my perfumes. Every time I got close to them, I could feel the muse favoring me... But, harm them? Why would I?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: I always cherish the sources of my inspiration. Otherwise, I wouldn't be willing to share my works with the public. I only wish to attract more beauties who understand my passion for perfume and are just as obsessed with the fragrances I create...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: I'm doing all this to overcome my creative block and craft the perfume of my dreams. That's why I need more and more inspiration...!
You suppose it all somehow makes sense within her unique logic. But your instinct is warning you that something is not right.
You recall Lucas's earnest plea and hopeful gaze, understanding that this interrogation cannot stop here.

Let's change the subject. Since you said that you got in contact with the victims to gain inspiration for your perfumes, you must have a deep impression of their appearances, right?
Then, tell me, have you seen the woman in this photo? She may not look the same age anymore, but her features should not have changed much.
Cassia gazes at the pretty young woman in the photo, seemingly trying to dredge up related details from the sea of memory. But she soon shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: I can't remember.

That doesn't surprise you. After all, according to the information Nightingale gathered, Lucas's daughter disappeared five or six years ago. She was among the earliest victims, so Cassia may not remember her clearly.
Then, you flip over the photo and point at the name written on the back as you ask the next question.
Her name is Fleur. Have you ever named one of your perfumes after that?
Cassia remains silent as she stares at the name written down lovingly.
But you know full well that the shackles have now tightly linked your minds together. You can gauge the Sinner's feelings through means other than superficial language or facial expressions.
You observe the quiet woman in front of you, following up with more questions while feeling for her reactions in your mind.
Fleur might not be a very rare name, but it is filled with her father's blessings. Please think carefully again. Have you ever made a perfume named Fleur?
Despite her silence, your shackles sense that Cassia is responding to that perfume. The repetition of the name Fleur has caused a few faint pulses.
You are certain she knows this name. Or at least... she responds to a certain perfume named Fleur.
You know her, don't you?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: I have no recollection of this person, but I remember every perfume I've ever made.
Then where are these perfumes now? Or have they all been sold?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: I do sell them, but I keep the ones that leave the most long-lasting scents.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Now, they are all stored in my perfumery.
If you don't mind, take me to see them. Perhaps there are some clues you've forgotten about.
